newsitem.title: ITALY: Venice put on practice flood alert.
newsitem.headline: Venice put on practice flood alert.

text.p: Officials and volunteers mounted a five-hour operation in Venice on Sunday to practice dealing with the threat of floods.
Operation "Serenissima 97" was organised to ensure that Venice would be prepared for any repetition of the devastating floods of 1966.
"It went very well," said Paolo Farneti, spokesman for the civil protection department in Rome.
The exercise began at seven a.m. (0500 GMT) and workers moved books and documents to safety in a library and simulated the evacuation of treasures from a church.
The operation also focused on transport systems and how people would be rescued.
Flooding is an ever-present threat. St Mark's Square, the city's lowest point, is flooded dozens of times a year.
